_comment: Membership of the catalogue is driven by the update registry; this file supplies grouping and editorial copy only. A registry plugin missing from here fails the build — see tools/build-catalogue.py.

entries.blurb: SMTP delivery, JSON-defined contact forms, delivery logging, and a developer extension API.
Adds name, address, section, HTML, email confirmation, and rating field types to EP Email forms.
AI-drafted replies to form submissions — review and send.
AI-powered spam triage. Classifies every submission, blocks confirmed spam silently, holds it in quarantine for review.
Managed delivery transport drivers for EP Email via send.elmspark.com.
Drag-and-drop file upload fields for EP Email forms.
AI-powered IMAP inbox handler with auto-reply.
Quiz field types with scoring and grading for EP Email forms.
Subscribers, lists, campaigns, autoresponders, content digests.
Legacy SendGrid delivery driver. For new sites use EP Newsletter Mailgun (our recommended provider) instead.
Record-in-browser voice messages with auto-transcription.
Brevo transactional transport for EP Email. 300/day free tier, no card required.
Turns contact-form submissions into a workable leads ledger with an always-current dashboard page.
Mailgun transactional transport for EP Email, with EU region support for GDPR-clean routing.
Brevo delivery driver for EP Newsletter. Forever-free 300/day tier, batch sending, signed webhooks.
Mailgun delivery driver for EP Newsletter. EU region, batch sending, HMAC-signed bounce handling. Our recommended provider.
Full affiliate programme with referral tracking, tiers, payouts, coupons.
Information product ecommerce base — memberships, downloads, licenses, bundles, subscriptions.
PayPal payment provider.
Styled checkout UI for EP Ecommerce.
Stripe payment provider.
Recurring billing with dunning, grace periods, and UK/EU compliance.
Product reviews with star ratings, verified-purchase badges, Schema.org markup.
Provider-agnostic print-on-demand. Sell physical products with live shipping quotes at checkout.
Gelato connector for EP Ecommerce — POD.
Printful connector for EP Ecommerce — POD.
Printify connector for EP Ecommerce — POD.
Prodigi connector for EP Ecommerce — POD. Products listed by SKU, as Prodigi has no catalogue API.
Appointment scheduling with services, staff, availability, Stripe payments.
Auto-created Zoom meetings for confirmed bookings.
Course and lesson management with multilingual content and progress tracking.
Full event platform with tickets, registrations, check-in PWA, Stripe Connect, Zoom, Schema.org, six EU languages, and depth EP Suite integration.
Holiday packages, enquiry-first booking, deposit/balance for independent travel agents.
Public registration, login, member levels, content gating.
Recurring class and event templates for EP Events — weekly, fortnightly and Nth-weekday series on a rolling timetable.
Date-range accommodation booking — check-in and check-out on a live availability calendar, per-night rates and half-day capacity. Hotels, B&Bs, holiday lets and pet boarding.
Pre-paid class credit packs, tracked in an append-only ledger with shelf-life expiry and auto-deduct at booking.
Instructors as first-class records: roster, public bio pages, pay-rate rules and a payroll CSV.
An Ask box in the admin. Ask about the business in plain English; Claude answers from live data.
The owner's operations command centre for a multi-location studio. Revenue, members, bookings, attendance, passes, waivers, payroll.
Versioned liability waivers and health declarations, e-signed and kept as immutable legal records.
A small "Built on PageMotor. Designed by ElmsPark." credit line in your site footer. One toggle, theme-agnostic.
A blog for PageMotor: Post content type, chronological index with excerpts and pagination, categories, tags, bylines, and previous/next navigation.
Breadcrumb navigation with Schema.org structured data.
Native card groups and grids with LLM-driven import. Thesis Focus Cards migration via add-on.
Migration add-on for EP Cards — imports from WordPress Thesis.
Comment system with moderation, threaded replies, WordPress import.
Hierarchical documentation site for PageMotor. Author docs in HTML or Markdown, organise by section, draft / improve / translate with Claude, six EU languages.
Visual inline page editor (work in progress).
FAQ management with accordion, search, Schema.org markup, voting.
Album-based image gallery with drag-and-drop upload, lightbox, EXIF display.
Enhanced EXIF extraction and display (lens, GPS, shooting mode).
Master crop, aspect-ratio frames, focal-point picker.
Serves paid video, audio and downloads from your own S3-compatible bucket behind links that expire. Automatic for EP Courses lessons.
Sidebar layout activation with manageable widget blocks.
Collect and display customer testimonials with star ratings.
GDPR-friendly YouTube embeds for PageMotor. Click-to-load thumbnails so no Google cookies fire on page load, no-cookie iframe host by default, optional thumbnail self-hosting.
Privacy-respecting server-side page view analytics. No cookies, no pixel.
Schema.org LocalBusiness emission for single-location businesses on PageMotor. Address, hours, geo, payment methods, areas served, and a coexistence handshake with EP SEO.
Multi-location LocalBusiness schema for PageMotor with built-in store finder. MapLibre + MapTiler tiles, postcode search, GDPR consent gating, six EU languages.
URL redirect manager with wildcards and 404 log.
RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 feed generation.
Site search with results page, form shortcode, basic analytics.
Open Graph, Twitter Card, favicon, Schema.org. Per-page overrides.
Dynamic XML sitemap with image references.
Share buttons for X/Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, email.
Tracked short URLs with click analytics and conversion attribution.
Dynamic robots.txt and llms.txt served from admin settings.
Real-time URL submission to IndexNow. Tells Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver the moment a page changes.
*Retired — built into PageMotor 0.10+ core (Site Settings → Google Fonts Delivery Service).*
Cookie consent, data subject requests, consent logging across EP Suite.
Passwordless login via WebAuthn. Sign-in is served from a dedicated page, since the PageMotor login screen takes no plugin markup.
Email-based password reset for admin accounts. *For PageMotor 0.10 and earlier — 0.11 brings password reset into core, so this plugin retires at that point.*
Claude Code CLI in your admin panel for server-side work.
Customer-facing AI website manager. Chat interface with nine LLM providers.
Activity log for content, users, and plugin events.
Visitor-facing AI chat bubble. Answers questions from your knowledge plus live booking data, captures enquiries. *Currently supplied and updated by ElmsPark directly.*
Outbound webhooks for Zapier, Make, Slack, or any URL.
System report for support requests.
The EP Suite automation engine. Trigger, conditions, actions, authored by talking to your site over MCP instead of a drag-and-drop builder.
Support ticket system with AI-drafted replies.

Read-only host diagnostics. A green/amber/red report of what your hosting can and cannot do for PageMotor: file writes, outbound HTTPS and SMTP, PHP version, extensions and limits, each with a plain fix.
Coming-soon and maintenance-mode overlays.
JSON-RPC API for remote PageMotor management via MCP clients.
Remote provisioning receiver for automated site setup.
Publish pages at a scheduled future time.
AI support chatbot for admins. Knows every EP Suite plugin.
WordPress companion plugin. Install on a WordPress source site to produce a JSON snapshot for migration to PageMotor. Read-only.
One secure, observable background-task scheduler for the whole EP Suite. A single heartbeat drains every due task exactly once.
A branded Command Centre for the PageMotor admin. Every active EP Suite plugin contributes its own panel.
